title: Como resolver problemas rítmicos siguiendo el pulso   Todos los instrumentos y cantantes

method.teacher_system: The teacher suggests using a metronome at a moderate speed and clapping along with it. He then explains how to align rhythmically by anticipating the beat rather than just reacting visually.

practices.what: Set a metronome app to a moderate speed, such as 60 or 70.
Try to clap along with the metronome using two fingers in each hand.
Practice 5 minutes daily using headphones with a metronome and clapping.

struggles.theme: Trouble keeping time or staying on beat while dancing, singing, or playing instruments
Entering too early or too late, losing track of time in songs

clicked.theme: The exercise and explanation are extremely helpful and working well

meant.theme: Expressing gratitude and blessings for the teacher and lesson

method.limits: The video is a teacher talk with no dancing demonstrated, focusing purely on rhythm exercises with a metronome.
